name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that installs Apache on Ubuntu, creates a self-signed HTTPS certificate, configures an HTTPS virtual host, deploys static content, enables SSL, and manages service handlers.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible playbook that hardens Apache TLS by enforcing TLS 1.2-only configuration and restarting affected services.

name: chef_platform_bootstrap_with_automate
description: Bootstraps Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, prepares host settings, and creates an initial Chef user and organization with generated credentials.

name: chef_infra_server_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Infra Server without Automate, including host preparation and creation of an initial administrative user, organization, and validator credentials.
